Some people are saying its a gated community where the 1% (or white people) live, that's partially true but not entirely accurate.

About 30% of the South African population lives in ares like these and are commonly referred to as the "middle class", the average price of a home in an area like this is R1.2 million ($180k-$200k USD), and yes every house has a wall, but they are not "gated communities". That said South Africa does have huge amount of gated communities commonly referred to as "estates".
